overloadMerges.note: picture is the doc's arrow-marked (←) output slot receiving the loaded picture; the draft parser had defaulted every parameter to direction:in.

params.name: fileName
params.description: Full pathname or bare file name of the picture file to read, or an empty string to show the standard Open file dialog.

params.name: picture
params.description: Field or variable receiving the loaded picture.
If passed, accept any type of file rather than only formats with an available codec.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Opens the picture file named by fileName from disk and loads it into the picture field or variable.

constraints: If fileName is a bare file name (no path), the file must be located next to the database structure file; under Windows the file extension must be included.
If fileName is an empty string, the standard Open file dialog box appears and the user selects both the file and the format.
The available picture formats/codecs can be enumerated with PICTURE CODEC LIST; without the trailing '*', only files matching a known codec are accepted.
